intro: This document serves as a comprehensive Land Cover / Land Use (LC/LU) nomenclature guideline for the Copernicus Protected Areas 2021-2024 product. It meticulously defines a four-level hierarchical classification system, aligning with MAES typology, for consistent mapping across diverse landscapes. The guideline provides detailed descriptions for each LC/LU class, outlining their geographic characteristics, input data considerations, and specific mapping rules. It further elaborates on object delineation, minimum mapping unit (MMU), minimum mapping width (MMW), and other critical criteria essential for accurate and standardised geospatial feature interpretation using Very High Resolution Earth Observation data.
